name: 劉人瑋
objective:
This is a one-semester graduate course on electromagnetic theory. 

The course slides are divided into four units:
- Chapter 1: Maxwell Equations
- Chapter 2: Propagation and Transmission
- Chapter 3: Radiation
- Chapter 4: Scattering

Mathematical tools are introduced as needed throughout the course.
schedule:
Week 1-3: Chapter 1
 Week 4-7: Chapter 2
*Week 8: Midterm
 Week 9-11: Chapter 3
 Week 12-15: Chapter 4
*Week 16: Final
 Week 17-18: Chapter 5 & Review
materials:
Liu, Jake W. Lectures on Electromagnetic Theory. 國立臺灣大學出版中心, 2026.

Course slides can be downloaded from:
https://jake-w-liu.github.io/courses/course_emt/
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
